p0.finding: After os.replace(staging, output), a verify/print exception only wrote a sibling postpublication_failed file; the canonical directory retained PASS manifest and RUN_COMPLETE.
p0.impact: A canonical PASS payload could survive a failed producer exit and be consumed as valid.
p0.required_repair: On every post-publication exception, atomically quarantine the canonical directory so the canonical path is absent.

p0.finding: The contract was loaded without a start/end hash equality check and was not a member of verify_inputs; the manifest hashed the contract only after capture.
p0.impact: A mutated post-run contract could be recorded as governing semantics that were actually read from older in-memory bytes.
p0.required_repair: Record contract_start before parsing and require the same SHA immediately before manifest publication.

p1.finding: verify_seal checked listed members but did not reject unlisted files.
p1.required_repair: Require exact equality between actual and sealed file populations.

p1.finding: Only validation filenames were checked; sequence CSV and event/mask/flow source bytes were not recorded and rehashed.
p1.required_repair: Bind and rehash the raw S10 validation sources.

p1.finding: The runtime checked the four named targets but did not assert that the complete runtime ConvTranspose2d set contains no additional module.
p1.required_repair: A complete-set assertion is preferred for an all-four scope claim.

supersession.reason: The producer and contract were repaired and re-locked after this review.
